 3 dead in Mt. Lebanon, prompting massive police presence near municipal building
 By
 Michael Guise 
 Michael Guise 
 Web Producer, CBS Pittsburgh 
 Michael Guise is a web producer for CBS Pittsburgh who has worked for KDKA-TV since 2019.
 Read Full Bio 
 Michael Guise 
 Updated on: November 3, 2026 / 6:07 PM EST 
 / CBS Pittsburgh
 Add CBS News on Google 
 Three people were found dead in Mt. Lebanon, prompting a massive police response near the municipal building, township officials said. 
 The three people were found dead on Tuesday evening, according to Laura Pace Lilley, the public information officer for Mt. Lebanon. It was not immediately known how they died or who the victims were. 
 There is a large police presence near the parking garage, located on Washington Road next to the municipal building. In a Facebook post , the Mt. Lebanon Police Department said there is an "ongoing police situation" near the municipal building, and there is no threat to the public. The call came in around 4:30 p.m.
 Three people were found dead in Mt. Lebanon, prompting a massive police response near the municipal building, authorities said. 
 (Photo KDKA)
 "We will release more details when we have them," Mt. Lebanon police said in the post. 
 Police did not release any additional details. 
 Mt. Lebanon is about 5 miles south of Pittsburgh.
